{{Quote|I must see what my own Padawan, Jin-Lo Rayce, is doing. Lost in the archives or exploring the secret passageways, no doubt.|Jocasta Nu|<ref name="STD">''[[Purge – Seconds to Die]]''</ref>}}
'''Jin-Lo Rayce''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprenticed to the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At the conclusion of the war and the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Rayce escaped the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Rayce then evaded the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] forces on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a few months and eventually stowed away on a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] headed for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], where he lived for a time. He then traveled to various planets in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], in search of surviving Jedi. After concluding that the Jedi were gone, Rayce traveled back to worlds where various [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] he had met lived and began establishing cells of [[Force Adept|Force adepts]]. Rayce styled his group the [[Agents of Ossus]], in memory of the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Jedi library]] planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], which had been [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|destroyed]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] millennia before.

==Biography==
[[File:JocastaNu-Db.png|thumb|left|150px|Jocasta Nu, Jin-Lo Rayce's Jedi Master]]
As a young boy, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] known as Jin-Lo Rayce was interested in the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and spent many nights in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He eventually became [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticed]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], who was the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] of the Archives.<ref name="TFU CG" /> Nu showed Rayce the secret passageways in and out of the Jedi Temple. During this time, Rayce befriended the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sha Koon]] and shared knowledge of these passageways with her.<ref name="STD" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final year of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|conflict]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which commanded the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Army]] to eliminate the Jedi.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> When Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]&mdash;formerly the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker&mdash;and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|assaulted]] the Jedi Temple, Rayce was given a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing blueprints of Coruscant's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]], as well as several datachips by Nu. He was instructed to flee the Temple through the secret passages. During Rayce's escape, Nu was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Vader when she tried to prevent the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] from activating the Temple's [[Jedi beacon/Legends|signal beacon]],<ref name="TFU CG" /> which would order any surviving Jedi to return to Coruscant.<ref name="Episode III" />

During the next few months, Rayce avoided the forces of the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He eventually managed to stow away on a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] bound for the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and resided there for a short while before beginning a quest to find any Jedi who had survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purge]]. Rayce traveled to various worlds in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], but to no avail. However, during his travels, Rayce met various individuals who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After concluding that there were no Jedi to be found, Rayce came back to the worlds where he had encountered these beings and began to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] them in the ways of the Force, even though he was only partially trained himself. Rayce organized many cells of Force-using agents on these worlds. He named his group of [[Force Adept|Force adepts]] the [[Agents of Ossus]], after [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]],<ref name="TFU CG" /> a planet that hosted the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] until its [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|destruction]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Ossus.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ossus, the planet after which Rayce named his organization of Jedi trainees]]
As a Jedi, Jin-Lo Rayce was amazed at the histories of the Jedi, and spent hours studying the records in the Jedi Archives.<ref name="TFU CG" /> During this time, Rayce bonded with the Kel Dor Jedi Sha Koon and even gave her information about the Jedi Temple's secret passageways.<ref name="STD" /> After the outbreak of the Jedi Purge, Rayce managed to avoid detection by Imperial forces, scavenging for resources that he needed in order to live. Eventually, after giving up on locating other Jedi, Rayce refocused his determination on forming a new order, even though he himself was only partially trained. Preservation of the lore of the Jedi was important to Rayce, and he viewed his agents as repositories of that knowledge who were in hiding, rather than lost.<ref name="TFU CG" />

==Powers and abilities==
Rayce used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], although he had only been partially trained in its use, and lost it when he escaped the Jedi Temple. He was also capable of using the Force to guide a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. Rayce taught his pupils how to use the Force to both hide from the Empire's [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Force-hunters]] and wield these same weapons. He showed the Agents of Ossus these various techniques he developed during his time on the streets of Coruscant and other planets.<ref name="TFU CG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jin-Lo Rayce was first mentioned in the [[2008]] ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' as part of the background for the Force-using organization called the Agents of Ossus.<ref name="TFU CG" />
